text_block_list.name: Super Creek
choice_data_list: Good morning! How was your time off?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I was able to have a nice, relaxing 
time~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You look well too, Trainer... Fufu, it 
looks like you were able to get some good 
rest.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Your cheerful greeting and your smile, 
Trainer, have put me in such a wonderful 
mood right now.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Let's not push ourselves too hard today 
and do our best at our own pace, okay? ♪

Super Creek had a light spring in her 
step. It seemed she got a good rest.
